help.title: Using the symbol editor
paragraphs: Select a standard, open the search with the bar at the top (or
), then configure the symbol, its amplifiers and its display. The preview and SIDC update as you edit.
clears the search, then closes it. A full SIDC typed into the search finds its symbol.
Paste a code into the Symbol identification code box and press
returns to the current code. In codes copied from a publication, * keeps the current identity or status. Messages below the box explain what was applied or why a code was rejected.

Edit text, under the preview, opens Amplifiers in Field positions: a box for each text field around the symbol, where milsymbol draws it (the boxes are spaced apart for typing; the preview shows the exact placement). The List view shows the fields that apply to the symbol, with their rules and tools; the others are listed, closed, under it. SVG is a scalable vector file; PNG is exported with a transparent background. Copying the SIDC alone does not include text or appearance settings.

Your symbol, text and style are saved automatically on this device. Reloading restores the draft. Reset clears modifiers; Undo reset restores them until your next edit. Copying a SIDC does not copy the draft.

MIL-STD-2525C and APP-6A/B use letter-based codes. The later editions use numeric codes. APP-6E uses the shared 2525E catalog here, with milsymbol's rendering conventions. It is a compatibility view, not a separate edition-specific catalog. Echelon and mobility are unspecified until selected.
